Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  1087, 1087/02F, 1087/100 Received: 29 January 2026,  1087/110, 1087/130 Received:  27 January 2026.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The installation of a single air conditioning condenser unit to the rear of the existing single storey studio outbuilding in the house's rear garden hereby permitted shall be a Mitsubishi Electric (PUZ-ZM125VDA) External Air Conditioning Condenser Unit mounted on a concrete plinth only and be permanently retained as such.  

Reasons:  To protect the character and appearance of the Conservation Area, neighbour living conditions and the local acoustic environment, in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and EQ5.

Condition : 4 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant, including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), hereby permitted, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the plant operates.  The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or one metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance with the latest British Standard 4142.  An alternative position for assessment/ measurement may be used to allow ease of access.  This must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria are achieved.  
b) The mechanical plant hereby permitted shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and be permanently maintained thereafter.  
c) Following installation of the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) hereby permitted, a post completion noise assessment shall be completed and submitted for approval to the Local Planning Authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions.  All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/ or its subsequent amendments.  The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the Local Planning Authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review.  If the plant fails to meet the specified standard, remedial measures shall be implemented immediately, and a post-completion noise assessment shall be carried out again.
